description: This file declares the SetLogLevelsService class, which manages IPC client connections and log level settings within the Rialto server component. It includes methods for handling client connections/disconnections and setting log levels, and maintains a set of connected clients.

classes.name: SetLogLevelsService
classes.description: A service class that manages IPC clients and log level configurations within the Rialto server.

methods.name: clientConnected
methods.description: Handles a new IPC client connection.

methods.name: setLogLevels
methods.description: Sets the log levels for default, client, IPC, and common logs.
